name: CoDesign (IMG.LY)
description: Gives coding agents IMG.LY's design engine as a local MCP server to create and resize posters, social posts, videos and print-ready PDFs as editable layers.

skills.name: Resize for Every Channel
skills.description: Resizes one design into Instagram, Story, LinkedIn, X and other formats while keeping every layer editable.

skills.name: Import Design Files
skills.description: Opens InDesign, Photoshop, PowerPoint and PDF files with their layers intact so the agent can restyle and re-export them.

skills.name: Print-Ready Export
skills.description: Exports print PDFs with CMYK color and bleed, plus PNG, SVG, HTML, IDML, PSD and MP4 video for social channels.

skills.name: Localize a Design
skills.description: Translates a design's text and reflows the layout to fit, including Arabic and other right-to-left scripts.

skills.name: Generate from CSV
skills.description: Creates one editable design per row of a CSV file from the same template, such as speaker cards or product tiles.
